===== help =====
grep -E '^[a-zA-Z_-]+:.*?## .*$'  Makefile | awk 'BEGIN {FS = ":.*?## "}; {printf "  \033[36m%-22s\033[0m %s\n", $1, $2}'

===== setup =====
pip install -e ".[path_a]"
playwright install chromium

===== install-training =====
pip install "ms-swift[llm]"

===== install-all =====
pip install -e ".[path_a]"
playwright install chromium
pip install "ms-swift[llm]"

===== load-tasks =====
python -m cua.path_a.load_mind2web_tasks --output /nonexistent/tasks.jsonl 

===== record =====
python -m cua.path_a.load_mind2web_tasks --output /nonexistent/tasks.jsonl 
test -n "$OPENAI_API_KEY" || (echo 'ERROR: OPENAI_API_KEY not set' && exit 1)
python -m cua.path_a.recorder \
		--tasks /nonexistent/tasks.jsonl \
		--output trajectories/ \
		--max-steps 15 \
		--viewport 1280x720 \
		--resume

===== convert =====
python -m cua.sft convert \
		--input trajectories/ \
		--output /nonexistent/training_data/ \
		--val-split 0.1 \
		--exclude-waste-steps \
		--meandering-mode subsample

===== train =====
python -m cua.sft convert \
		--input trajectories/ \
		--output /nonexistent/training_data/ \
		--val-split 0.1 \
		--exclude-waste-steps \
		--meandering-mode subsample
python -m cua.sft train \
		--config config.yaml \
		--dataset /nonexistent/training_data/sft_dataset.jsonl \
		 \
		 \
		

===== all =====
pip install -e ".[path_a]"
playwright install chromium
python -m cua.path_a.load_mind2web_tasks --output /nonexistent/tasks.jsonl 
test -n "$OPENAI_API_KEY" || (echo 'ERROR: OPENAI_API_KEY not set' && exit 1)
python -m cua.path_a.recorder \
		--tasks /nonexistent/tasks.jsonl \
		--output trajectories/ \
		--max-steps 15 \
		--viewport 1280x720 \
		--resume
python -m cua.sft convert \
		--input trajectories/ \
		--output /nonexistent/training_data/ \
		--val-split 0.1 \
		--exclude-waste-steps \
		--meandering-mode subsample
python -m cua.sft train \
		--config config.yaml \
		--dataset /nonexistent/training_data/sft_dataset.jsonl \
		 \
		 \
